summary: Full platform test for EuroVault presentation quality check. Fixed critical AdminDashboard crash (fmt undefined). Found 13 hardcoded PT strings leaking into EN/ES modes across admin and client pages.

bug_fixed.issue: ReferenceError: fmt is not defined — crashed Admin Dashboard on load
bug_fixed.fix: Added `const fmt = (v) => new Intl.NumberFormat('pt-PT', { style: 'currency', currency: 'EUR' }).format(v || 0);` before fmtDate definition

ui_bugs.issue: Kanban column headers hardcoded PT: 'Novo', 'Contactado', 'Interessado', 'Depositado'. Not translated to EN/ES.
ui_bugs.fix: Replace static labels with `t('adm_status_novo')` etc. or derive from translation map

ui_bugs.issue: Button text 'Criar Agente' hardcoded PT at line 228. Should use t('adm_agents_create_btn') = 'Create Agent' in EN

ui_bugs.component: AdminAgents - modal title and delete button
ui_bugs.issue: Hardcoded PT: 'Criar Novo Agente' (modal title, line 47), 'Eliminar' (delete btn, line 209)
ui_bugs.fix: Use t() keys for these strings

ui_bugs.component: AdminContracts - status labels and action buttons
ui_bugs.issue: STATUS_LABELS object hardcoded PT: 'Pendente', 'Preenchido', 'Assinado' (lines 15-17). Action buttons 'Copiar Link', 'Copiado!', 'Abrir', 'Assinado: ...' all hardcoded PT (lines 124, 393, 425, 429)
ui_bugs.fix: Use t() keys for all these strings

ui_bugs.issue: Priority/lead tags ('Alta Prioridade', 'Precisa Mais Info', 'Quente', 'Frio', 'Aguarda Doc.') hardcoded PT in TAG_COLORS map (lines 234, 1433). Show as PT even in EN/ES mode.
ui_bugs.fix: Use t() keys for tag labels or map them to translation keys

ui_bugs.issue: 'Sessão encriptada e registada por auditoria.' hardcoded PT at line 214. Shown in EN/ES mode.
ui_bugs.fix: Add translation key e.g. t('adm_login_audit') and add to EN/ES translations

ui_bugs.issue: 'Sem pedidos {statusFilter}...' hardcoded PT at line 157. Shown when no withdrawals match filter.
ui_bugs.fix: Use t() key for empty state message

ui_bugs.issue: Entire welcome modal hardcoded PT: 'BEM-VINDO À EUROVAULT', 'Olá, {name}! 👋', 'A sua conta foi criada com sucesso.', 'O seu gestor irá contactá-lo em breve...', 'Aceder à Minha Conta' (lines 120-133). Shown in EN mode after registration.
ui_bugs.fix: Use t() keys for all modal strings

ui_bugs.issue: toast.success('Sessão iniciada com sucesso!') hardcoded PT at line 74. Shown in EN/ES mode after login.
Country names in dropdown hardcoded PT ('Espanha', 'França', 'Alemanha', etc.) regardless of language setting.
ui_bugs.fix: Use translated country names via t() or conditionally map based on current language

issues: Header shows 'DATA ANALYTICS PLATFORM' which may conflict with investment platform identity — intentional for regulatory reasons?

action_items: AdminKanban.js: Translate COLUMNS labels using t() (lines 26-31)
AdminAgents.js: Replace hardcoded 'Criar Agente', 'Criar Novo Agente', 'Eliminar' with t() keys (lines 47, 209, 228)
AdminContracts.js: Translate STATUS_LABELS + action buttons 'Copiar Link', 'Abrir', 'Assinado' using t() keys
AdminDashboard.js: Translate priority tags ('Alta Prioridade', 'Quente', etc.) using t() keys (lines 234, 1433)
AdminLogin.js: Replace hardcoded 'Sessão encriptada e registada por auditoria.' with t() key (line 214)
AdminWithdrawals.js: Replace hardcoded 'Sem pedidos' empty state with t() key (line 157)
Register.js: Translate entire welcome modal to use t() keys (lines 120-133)
Login.js: Replace hardcoded 'Sessão iniciada com sucesso!' toast with t() key (line 74)
Register.js: Translate country dropdown options based on current language
critical_code_review_comments: CRITICAL BUG FIXED: AdminDashboard.js was missing `const fmt` function definition, causing a ReferenceError that crashed the entire admin dashboard on load.

Pattern: Multiple admin pages (Kanban, Agents, Contracts, Withdrawals) have hardcoded Portuguese strings instead of using the t() translation function. The LangContext.js has correct translation keys for EN/ES but they are not being used in these components.
Register welcome modal and Login success toast are entirely in Portuguese even in EN/ES mode — high visibility for a presentation.

success_rate.frontend: 75% (core flows work, but ~10 hardcoded PT string leaks in EN/ES mode)

seed_data_creation: Created test users via backend tests: test_ev_030ba149@test.com, test_reg_* variants (TEST_ prefixed)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Main fix needed: translate hardcoded PT strings across AdminKanban, AdminAgents, AdminContracts, AdminWithdrawals, AdminLogin, Register, Login. The fmt bug in AdminDashboard was fixed in this iteration. Backend is fully functional (26/26 tests pass). Admin dashboard EN/ES/PT translations work. Legal pages work in all 3 languages. Client registration/login/dashboard work. Contract public page works.

rca_of_issues.fmt_undefined_crash: The AdminDashboard.js file was missing the `fmt` currency formatter function which is defined in all other admin pages (AdminKanban, AdminWithdrawals, etc.). The function was referenced at lines 749, 1463, 1473 but never defined. Fix: Added `const fmt = (v) => new Intl.NumberFormat('pt-PT', ...).format(v || 0)` before fmtDate.
rca_of_issues.hardcoded_pt_strings: Multiple admin and client pages hardcode Portuguese strings instead of using the t() translation function from LangContext. The translation keys exist in LangContext.js for EN/ES but the components don't call t(). Each file needs to replace hardcoded strings with t('key') calls and add the corresponding EN/ES translation keys where missing.
